meta.title: A user without event-create permission cannot pull PR lines
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The vocabulary cannot create a second restricted user session or configure the acting user's team permissions.
The valid request body for pulling PR lines is not specified; the represented body uses available line_items and product_uuid fields but may not match the required request schema.
The vocabulary has no verification that the rejected request wrote nothing.
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (trade: create_record permission disabled for the acting user) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer sends the “create the draft event” request, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
